'''Termites''' are insects responsible for the structural decay of the [[Colossal Wyrm Remains]], occasionally spawning whilst training at the [[Colossal Wyrm Agility Course]]. There are three possible spawn points for both the basic and advanced courses, plus two spawn points shared by both courses.

The player will automatically scoop up termites upon reaching some whilst running through the course, and may additionally receive [[blessed bone shards]] that they've chipped off the remains.

The jars of [[termites]] are then given to [[Worm Tongue]] in exchange for [[Worm Tongue's Wares|rewards]].
